summary: feat(settings): wire the passkey signal into FlowSetup2faPrompt
description:
Because:

- The passkey copy added to FlowSetup2faPrompt sat behind a prop nothing
  set, so the new strings could never render for a user.
- handleNavigation already receives isPasskeySession from the passkey
  sign-in flow, but createSigninLocationState dropped it before the
  AAL2-RP divert to /inline_totp_setup.

This commit:

- Forwards isPasskeySession from NavigationOptions into
  SigninLocationState.
- Passes it from the InlineTotpSetup container through the page to
  FlowSetup2faPrompt.
- Gives the success banner a stable id, and lets an error banner replace
  it rather than stack with it.
- Rewords the passkey FTL comment so it stands alone for localizers.
- Covers the propagation in unit tests and asserts the banner in the two
  AAL2 passkey functional tests.
